## 📚 Documentation Request

Thank you for helping us improve our documentation! Please fill out the form below.

### ✅ Checklist

Before submitting, please verify:

- [ ] I have searched for [existing documentation](https://github.com/Niconikun/Rocket-Simulator---GUI/tree/master/docs) that might already cover this topic
- [ ] This is not a bug report (use the Bug Report template instead)
- [ ] This is not a feature request (use the Feature Request template instead)

### 📝 Request Details

**What documentation is missing or needs improvement?**
A clear description of what documentation you're requesting.

**Current documentation:**
- Link to existing documentation (if applicable):
- What's currently covered:
- What's missing:

### 🎯 Type of Documentation

What type of documentation are you requesting?

- [ ] Usage guide / Tutorial
- [ ] API reference
- [ ] Examples / Code samples
- [ ] Installation instructions
- [ ] Configuration guide
- [ ] Troubleshooting guide
- [ ] Architecture overview
- [ ] Other (please describe):

### 📊 Priority

How important is this documentation?
- [ ] Critical (essential for using the project)
- [ ] High (would help many users)
- [ ] Medium (would be nice to have)
- [ ] Low (minor improvement)
